subject: Network Theory
questionText:
When we apply sinusoidal input to a system, then 
output is sinusoidal having _____ frequency, _____ 
amplitude & _____ phase.  
 
(a) same, same, same 
 
(b) same, different, different 
 
(c) different, same, same 
 
(d) different, different, different
explanation: Practice Question from Network Theory DPP-26 (Sinusoidal Steady State Analysis).
